item.title: Man shot to death at Potomac senior living facility was millionaire philanthropist from Maine: report
item.description: An 87-year-old man who was shot to death at a senior living facility in Potomac was a millionaire philanthropist, FOX News reports. Montgomery County police responded to the Cogir Potomac Senior Living facility in the 10800 block of Potomac Tennis Lane just after 7:30 a.m. on Saturday, Feb. 14.
